explanation: Gift-giving is welcomed in UAE business and social settings as long as it follows a few consistent rules: avoid alcohol, pork products, or imagery of dogs, and give with the right hand or both hands together rather than the left. Common, safe choices are dates, chocolates, or pastries, and gifts are typically opened in private rather than in front of the giver.
local_tip: Offer the gift with your right hand or both hands, and don't be offended if it isn't opened in front of you.

also_check.note: Gift-giving is highly ritualized; sets of four are avoided, and gifts are presented with both hands.
Business gifts are often unnecessary and should stay small and practical if given at all.
Similar rules around alcohol, pork, and hand use apply, but gift-giving is less common at a first meeting.

sources.title: Gift Giving Etiquette in the Middle East
